label: Full Text Search (capability)
type: the search capability provided by the Search Service - the CAPABILITY, not the index artifact
note: Canonical id for the server-side capability, resolving part of a FIVE-WAY ID SPLIT the corpus accumulated: fts:full-text-search, search:full-text-index, index:full-text, cbl:full-text-search, sdk:full-text-searching-with-sdk. Two of those splits are legitimate and are NOT folded here - cbl:full-text-search is a different product (Couchbase Lite) and sdk:full-text-searching-with-sdk is a how-to page id. The rest was pure namespace drift across batches. Capability and index artifact are kept as two ids on purpose (see search:full-text-index), because search-service.md needs both and they are not the same thing. ROUND 16 MOVED THE `index:full-text` ALIAS OFF THIS RECORD and onto search:full-text-index. That id's label is 'Full Text index (Search service)' - the artifact - so it was aliased to the one of the two records that says of itself it is not the artifact. The two records distinguish themselves explicitly and in capitals, and the alias still went to the wrong one, because AN ALIAS IS A CLAIM ABOUT A REFERENT AND NOTHING CHECKS REFERENTS. verify-registry-ids.py checks that an alias is well-formed and does not collide; the enum checks that a status declaration matches the registry. Neither can ask whether two ids denote the same thing.
relates_to_competency_question: What can the Search Service do?
